author: pdobacz
content:
tl;dr: EIP-8163 exists to unblock R&D on EVM extensions, and there are already examples to name: Monad's MIP-7, MIP-4 and MIP-8, execution designs on top of Cadence, and flexible account authentication. Outside Monad, Rootstock and Tron have or had custom opcodes.

Happy to take feedback either here or in the EthMag thread.
